scope_note: Half-ton Chevrolet 3100-series trucks (Advance Design 1947 to 1955 first series; Task Force 1955 second series to 1959), incl. 3104 pickup, 3105 panel, 3106/3116 Suburban, 3124 Cameo Carrier (1955-58), 3134 Fleetside and 31 Apache (1958-59). 3200 long-box half-ton (1955-59) shares the engines. 3600/3800 and heavier excluded. HP is advertised gross.
excluded_note: Loadmaster 235 and Jobmaster 261 sixes, Taskmaster 265 V8 (1955 heavy-duty name) and 322/348 Loadmaster V8s were heavy/medium-duty engines only, never half-ton options (1948, 1951, 1954, 1955 brochures; 1950 GM engine ID table). Not listed.

1955.note: 1955 second series only. Early literature (March 1955 Engineering Features booklet; full-line brochure) lists the V8, there called Taskmaster, only as regular equipment in the 5000-series LCF; the revised GM spec data list it as an RPO for 3100-3200 under the light-duty name Trademaster. So it was most likely added during the model year. Net 126 hp.
